g.text: Conditional model estimates · values shown to three significant digits · full precision in plot_points.csv / .json
SRAM ACIM: Analog transfer and 256-row read stability unverified. Nominal 9-bit code is not ENOB.
SRAM DCIM: Exact nominal digital mapping. Native SRAM/clock timing abstraction; no SPICE signoff.
1T1R RRAM: Segmented, approximate Q4 output. Stiff read rail and successful bounded program-verify assumed; no ENOB claim.
300 / 350 / 400 K: finite fixed-architecture design scenarios with native automatic sizing. The 350 K warm reference is not a median.

text.tspan: Decimal MB/s = 10⁶ Byte/s. =/; =/Δ. Qualifications and source fields are preserved in the machine-readable exports.
